title: ra-periop-gc-analysis: RA perioperative glucocorticoid ICU cohort analysis code and web risk estimator
description: Data-extraction SQL and analysis code accompanying the multi-database observational study of glucocorticoid exposure, in-hospital infection, and short-term mortality in surgical patients with rheumatoid arthritis (MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD, INSPIRE, NWICU). Includes a pure front-end web risk estimator for in-hospital infection. No patient-level data are included: all source databases are governed by PhysioNet data-use agreements, so users must obtain the databases and run the SQL extraction under their own DUA.
